statement: TSMC announced in July a further US$100 billion investment in Arizona, bringing its total planned Arizona investment to US$265 billion.
why: Leading-edge wafer and packaging capacity added on U.S. soil is the single biggest lever on how many accelerators can be built later this decade.

impact.mechanism: Committed foundry capital expands leading-edge wafer and advanced packaging capacity, relieving the upstream constraint on merchant GPU and custom accelerator output over time.

evidence.excerpt: TSMC announced in July a further US$100 billion investment in Arizona, bringing the total planned investment to US$265 billion.

confidence.basis: Secondary newspaper report restating a previously announced company commitment; no filing cited.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: value 20.0 -> 265.0 (tol 1%); sources: Taipei Times
